description: This is a multi-language website built with React
company_description: Atilal Company brings trusted agricultural products — fertilizers, seeds, and pesticides — to support sustainable farming across Libya.
mission_description: To deliver innovative agricultural solutions that improve crop quality and promote sustainability across Libya.
vision_description: To be the first trusted partner for Libyan farmers in all agricultural products and services.
about_title: The success story of Atilal Agricultural Materials
about_content: Atilal Agricultural Import Company, founded in Misrata in 2019, specializes in importing and marketing high-quality agricultural products. We support Libyan farmers with reliable products and transparent, dedicated service. We supply the Libyan market with top-quality, internationally certified fertilizers, seeds, and pesticides. Working with trusted international partners, we ensure compliance with Libyan standards and Ministry of Environment requirements.
hero_heading: Your trusted partner for agricultural growth in Libya
hero_subheading: We provide high-quality fertilizers, seeds, and pesticides from internationally certified suppliers to ensure reliable products that meet the needs of the Libyan agricultural market.
about_paragraph_one: Green Field Company is a Libyan business founded in 2002 that specializes in importing and distributing fertilizers, seeds, pesticides, and irrigation supplies from trusted global partners. We focus on delivering high-quality products tailored to Libyan soil and farmers' needs.
about_paragraph_two: Throughout our journey we have focused on products that help farmers work more efficiently and achieve better crop results. We continuously expand our portfolio to ensure we meet the needs of Libyan farmers in every season.
vertical_step_one_description: We deliver internationally certified agricultural solutions with premium specifications to guarantee outstanding results for your crops.
vertical_step_two_title: Deep expertise in the Libyan market
vertical_step_two_description: With years of experience in Libya, we design solutions tailored to local environments and farming conditions.
vertical_step_three_description: Our specialized technical team provides continuous guidance to help farmers get the best value from every product.
vertical_step_four_description: We ensure a steady supply chain with quick delivery across Libya so your operations never stop.
contact_section_description: Reach out for any inquiries about our services or products. Our team is happy to assist you through the following channels.
contact_description: Our team is ready to provide you with the best agricultural solutions. You can reach us by phone or email. We also welcome you to visit our main headquarters in Misrata to discuss your needs in person and see our latest products. Your satisfaction is our priority.
fertilizers_description: We provide a variety of NPK fertilizer formulations suitable for all growth stages, with certified quality and high standards.
seeds_description: We offer certified alfalfa and vegetable seeds, including LUNA alfalfa seeds imported from the United States.
supplies_description: We provide materials that help farmers improve work quality and make daily tasks easier.
bountiful_land: Want bountiful land? Choose our certified seeds.
partners_description: We proudly partner with trusted international companies in Europe and the USA to provide certified products that meet the needs of the Libyan market, ensuring quality and innovation in everything we deliver.
